text:
体力是这一局「还剩几条命」，和战斗里的生命、耐力不是一回事：那两样每场重置，体力跨战斗保留。输一场普通战斗扣体力，精英扣得更多，输给猎手也扣；归零就是战败。核心那一场是例外，输了不论剩多少体力都直接战败。

休息点能回体力，扎营多扣一些倒计时、多回一些；安德烈乌斯首次战败于敌人时免罚，科技「不屈」让每次败仗少扣一点（最少还是扣一点）；侵蚀区里走路、逃跑失败、某些事件也会扣。上限由角色定，章节与局外加成能加。{char}的体力在地图屏上一直看得见。

texts.en:
Vitality is how many lives you have left in this run. It is not the same as Health or Stamina in battle: those reset every battle, while Vitality carries over from one battle to the next. Losing an ordinary battle costs Vitality, losing to an elite costs more, and losing to a Hunter costs some too; at zero, you are defeated. The core battle is the exception: lose it and you are defeated no matter how much Vitality you have left.

Rest spots restore Vitality; making camp costs more Countdown and restores more. Andreus takes no penalty the first time he is defeated by an enemy, and the Undaunted tech makes each lost battle cost a little less (it still costs at least one). Walking in Erosion zones, failing to flee and some events also cost Vitality. Your maximum is set by your character, and chapters and between-run bonuses can raise it. {char}'s Vitality is always shown on the map screen.
